scientific_integrity: Proof includes selector induction and both Borel–Cantelli directions, uses countable formula language, and does not claim finite experiments certify an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The zero-one classification applies only to countable zero-outdegree-leaf stars with deterministic positive root weights and independent identically distributed leaf atomic valuations from a law supported on (0,1] having mass arbitrarily near zero; not arbitrary infinite frames, correlated valuation laws, or uniform witnessing over all possible assignments. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Tail-mass criterion for almost-sure witnessing on infinite Gödel-modal stars
